digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify CI/CD testing architecture, Pandoc corpus verification
propositions: Gerrit Verify currently runs complete real-Pandoc corpus conversions on the macOS critical path, consuming 184+ seconds per run.
The proposal moves complete corpus replay to a dedicated external-integration job matrix with ubuntu-latest and macos-latest runners, away from hot-path CI.
ADR 0096 narrows supersession of ADR 0095 to only the test execution boundary; all production renderer invariants, pin/provenance probes, and safety assertions remain in Verify.
Gerrit Verify will retain three representative live corpus contracts plus compact provenance probes, with every assertion class verified against committed deterministic outputs.
The external-integration workflow currently has no macOS runner; implementation must add an explicit pandoc-corpus-replay matrix job.
Version drift and platform-specific binary fingerprints must fail fast, with deterministic fixture regeneration documented and paired A/B evidence required at implementation.
